mapper.app.title: Mapper
mapper.calibration.cardsHint: Grid: square cells, so a stretched surface shows at once. Focus: turn the lens until the fine lines are crisp. Colours: bars, greys, near black and near white. White: an even light, overlaps. They change nothing in the scene.
mapper.calibration.fitHint: Each size is the pixels the layer covers on the output: a media of that size is shown 1:1. Compose over its template; the mapper warps the result.
mapper.connect.addressHint: Or the address on the mapper's status card (Tab on its keyboard, or the remote's select key).
mapper.connect.codeLabel: the code on the mapper's screen
mapper.connect.enterCode: Enter the code shown on the mapper's screen.
mapper.connect.looking: Looking for mappers on this network...
mapper.connect.showCodeOnMapper: Show a code on the mapper
mapper.connect.title: Mapper editor
mapper.dashboard.hint: A click plays a clip, a second one stops it; a column's title plays or stops the column; an empty column stops everything.
mapper.devices.following: {name} leads this machine: what you change here goes away at its next change.
mapper.devices.heading: Several machines, one picture
mapper.devices.identify: Show its name on its output
mapper.devices.noneFound: No other mapper seen on the network. Type its address if it is on another network.
mapper.devices.offline: {host}: no answer, it comes back by itself
mapper.discovery.wait: Asked a moment ago: the code is coming, or try again in a few seconds.
mapper.discovery.wrongCode: Wrong code, or no code on the mapper. Three wrong ones close it: ask for a new one.
mapper.edge.hint: Soft edge, {side} side. Blue: where the gradient ends. Red: where the cut puts its end, or hides up to.
mapper.files.folder: Folder of media to send to the mapper
mapper.files.media: Media to send to the mapper
mapper.files.scene: Scene file to bring to the mapper
mapper.frame.contain: The whole picture, with bars where it does not reach.
mapper.frame.cover: The zone is full; what exceeds is cut.
mapper.frame.height: The height of the picture spans the zone.
mapper.frame.noPicture: This device gives no picture of this media: the sliders still work.
mapper.frame.stretch: The whole picture, deformed to the zone.
mapper.frame.width: The width of the picture spans the zone.
mapper.history.heading: History
mapper.history.hint: Click an action to go back to it. What plays stays as it is.
mapper.language.name: English
mapper.library.dragHint: Drag a tile onto a cell of the grid, or click it and then click cells.
mapper.library.dropHint: Or drop them on this window: they play on the selected layer.
mapper.link.notPaired: not paired with this mapper yet
mapper.mask.heading: Masks, crop, edge blend
mapper.mask.hint: Click empty space to add a point to the mask, shift-click a point to take it out. Curve bends the chosen points, or all of them; drag their handles. The two crop corners are points too.
mapper.mask.name: mask {slot}
mapper.options.arrowStepLabel: pixels an arrow moves a point
mapper.options.focusRing: Focus ring on the canvases (the keyboard's yellow outline)
mapper.options.frame: Frame around the selected layer, on the projector
mapper.options.heading: Options
mapper.options.hud: Status card and address on the projector
mapper.options.shiftStepLabel: pixels an arrow moves a point with Shift
mapper.output.pointEdges: Click an edge of a layer to soften it.
mapper.output.pointEmpty: An empty scene: Add makes a layer that covers the whole output.
mapper.output.pointHint: Click a zone to select it; drag it or use the arrows to move it whole. Click a point; the arrows move it by 1 pixel, with Shift by 10; Tab goes to the next one.
mapper.output.pointLinking: Click a corner of another layer: it joins this point and they move together.
mapper.props.name: name
mapper.props.noClip: No clip chosen on this layer: click one in its row of the grid.
mapper.room.heading: Room
mapper.room.hint: Shapes come from the corners and the lens. Link the corners two faces share (in Output) to join them; one real size sets the scale of what is linked to it. Metres, projector at the origin. The GLB opens in three.js, model-viewer, Blender.
mapper.room.throwLabel: throw ratio, distance over picture width
mapper.scenes.hint: The media stay on the mapper: a scene file names them, so another mapper needs the same files. Loading or starting new first keeps what was on as "previous".
mapper.scenes.now: On now: {name}. Save writes your changes to it; they are also kept across restarts.
mapper.scenes.nowUnnamed: On now: a scene with no name. It keeps itself across restarts.
mapper.scenes.previous: previous (before the last load or new)
mapper.sound.hint: The sound leaves by the device's own output: its speaker, or what is plugged into it. The device's volume keys set the level above this mixer.
mapper.sound.noSound: This mapper's layers have no sound yet: only Android plays it.
mapper.state.notSaved: the mapper does not answer: the columns are not saved
mapper.status.nothing: Nothing is running on the device.
mapper.transfer.description: You can close this: the files keep going.
mapper.transfer.noMedia: no media in what you sent
mapper.transfer.title: Sending to the mapper
